issues.detail: The Greek 'εκ του πληρωματος αυτου' (ek tou plērōmatos autou) means 'from His fullness,' but the Vietnamese translation uses 'bởi sự đầy dẫy của Ngài' (by/because of His fullness). While 'bởi' can sometimes mean 'from', in this context it shifts the source/origin to a causal relationship.
